about_html:
We are an international production and service company, operating as a production hub.

We are based in Bangkok and Warsaw and produce TV commercials, TV shows, documentary films and music videos. We offer high quality full production service and line producing in Poland and South East Asia no matter the size of Clients project. From location scouting, casting, budgeting and production planning, to the shoots in challenging locations and complex set constructions we provide the essential tools necessary for successful and cost efficient shoots. Over the last few years we successfully work with local and international clients among which Mercedes-Benz, Skoda, SAB Miller, T-Mobile, Asahi, Reckitt Benckiser, O2, Nivea, Samsung, TV channels as Canal +, TVN and production houses such as: Stink Films, Czar.de, Dynamo Films, Opus Film and OTO Film.
production_poland_html:
Located in the heart of Europe, Poland has everything essential for film production:

Efficient technical and logistical support, highly professional film crews, scenic mountains, charming countryside, countless expanses of water, swatches of forest, beautiful extended coastline, and even stretches of desert which in many spots calls to mind the beaches of Africa. A wide diversity of architecture ranging from historic European castles and palaces to modern international business buildings is available within a short driving time.
production_asia_html:
We have been offering full production services in Thailand & South East Asia from the beginning of 2017.

Within this time we have become a reliable partner in Asia for our clients such as: Mercedes-Benz, T-Mobile, SAB Miller, Asahi, Stink Films, Dynamo Film, OTO Film, Opus Film, CANAL+, TVN.

Why Asia?

  • Production costs more attractive than in Southern Europe or South Africa.
  • Thailand ranked number 1 on the global Covid recovery Index.
  • High quality international production service available, crews with international experience of working on large international projects.
  • European service producer from ONES always there to take care of the whole production.
  • Established workflow for remote shoots.
  • Stunning and diverse locations “for every brief” – from exotic beaches, paradise islands to modern business cities, luxury villas and location with European look.
  • International casting available locally – unlimited choice of European actors and models for your spot.
  • International DoPs available locally.
film_html:
WILD CITY

ABOUT A FILM

Wild City is a creative documentary film by a multi-award winning director and cinematographer Krystian Matysek. The film follows the life of animals living in the cities and focuses on how they live within human society and their encounters and relations with the people. It is a current global view at the state of the modern world of animals close to humans and within an urban environment and perhaps a prophetic look at what will remain in one or two hundred years. The storytelling is balancing on the edge of two worlds: the human community and wildlife. The collision of two worlds and the necessity of sharing the living space between humans and animals is a field for observing the behaviour and interaction between them. How does the behaviour of animals living near human beings change? How are they perceived by the people? Can a man be willing to share his living space with its once indigenous inhabitants? And how does attitude towards urban wildlife look in different cultures?

MESSAGE OF THE FILM

The idea of the film is to raise an ecological awareness among the people living in the cities. To reflect on where we drove the animals in the modern world, what their place is and whether they still have their place on this planet. Through attracting attention and observation of how the animals deal with living in the cities, the film will try to increase peoples sensibility towards the current general existential conditions of the animals on our planet.

production_spain_html:
Barcelona, Catalonia and the whole of Spain — one production base for Southern Europe.

From 2026 ONES runs its third base in Barcelona, extending the same full service model we built in Warsaw and Bangkok to Spain and the Iberian Peninsula. Mediterranean light for most of the year, over 300 sunny days, and locations within two hours of the city that double for almost anywhere: Barcelona’s modernist and brutalist architecture, the beaches and coves of Costa Brava, the vineyards of Penedès, the Pyrenees, the semi-desert of Monegros and the industrial ports of Tarragona.
